**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4078.

What shipped, both halves: (1) session gating — the console's landing route now sits behind `AuthGuard` (it mounted the whole data layer anonymously before) and `ConnectedShellInner` withholds the metadata tree until `get-session` resolves, so no `/meta/*` fires before the session answer for any consumer; (2) structured HTTP failure logging — method/url/status/code now live in the message string itself (`HTTP request failed: GET /api/v1/meta/object -> 401 [UNAUTHORIZED]`), ending `[object Object]`, with the structured bag still attached and nothing newly silenced (a post-gate 401 stays a visible, identified error — pinned).

The card's "investigate the doubling" clause paid off beyond its premise: the double-fire was measured to be **auth-independent** — MetadataProvider's preview-mode effect cleared the cache on mount, discarding render-phase fetches mid-flight and doubling `meta/object`+`meta/view` on EVERY mount, signed-in included; that's fixed (the mount-run skip), plus a ~1s failure back-off distinct from the 5-minute TTL so a failed type isn't hammered while `refresh()`/`invalidate()` still bypass immediately. Before/after on the real provider stack: 5 requests → 3 per mount — the fix removed two requests from the signed-in path too.

Review notes: measurement-first (the recording harness reproduced the card's exact table), reverse verification 14/15 red with the one green being the non-regression direction, reported as-is instead of reshaped. Post-merge re-run of every gate after origin/main advanced ~35 files.
